hypotheses.hypothesis: Comparing two secret values c and c2 directly leaks the difference between them.
hypotheses.trigger_condition: Two different values of c and c2
hypotheses.test_vector_hint: Run 10000 calls with c=c1, then 10000 calls with c=c2, measure delta.

hypotheses.trigger_condition: Any two different values of norm_exceeds_bound(z, pk)

hypotheses.test_vector_hint: Run 10000 calls with norm_exceeds_bound(z, pk)=true (class A) vs 10000 calls with norm_exceeds_bound(z, pk)=false (class B), measure delta.
